career_ladder.note: Tripura Civil Service (TCS) is the premier state civil executive cadre under the Government of Tripura, governed by the Tripura Civil Service Rules. Direct recruits enter at Tripura Civil Service Grade-II (Group 'A' Gazetted) at Pay Matrix Level 14 (₹54,000 entry basic pay under the Tripura State Civil Services (Revised Pay) (First Amendment) Rules, 2018). Officers advance through TCS Grade-I (Senior Grade), Junior Administrative Grade (JAG), and Selection Grade, culminating in promotion and induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) Tripura Cadre or State Supertime Scale.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the Tripura Civil Service (TCS Grade-II) is conducted under the Tripura Civil Service (Appointment by Combined Competitive Examination) Regulations by TPSC across three stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening test of 200 marks, 150 minutes, with 0.25 negative marking; 10x vacancies shortlist); Main Examination (Conventional written examination of 6 compulsory papers totaling 800 marks: Language Paper I 100m, Language Paper II 100m, GS I 150m, GS II 150m, GS III 150m, GS IV 150m); and Personality Test / Interview (100 marks; 1:3 ratio), totaling 900 marks for final rank list. Allied state administrative services are recruited through the Tripura Combined Competitive Examination for Miscellaneous Posts (Advt. 18/2025: Prelims 100m, Mains 200m, Interview 20m = 220 total marks for posts including Superintendent of Taxes, Inspector of Small Savings, and Supervisor).

papers.paper_name: General Studies & Aptitude (English Composition 40 marks, History of Modern India & Indian National Movement 40 marks, Geography of India & Tripura 40 marks, Indian Polity & Economy 40 marks, General Science & Environment 20 marks, General Mental Ability & Reasoning 20 marks)
papers.negative_marking: One-fourth (0.25) mark deducted as penalty for each incorrect response (four options per MCQ; unanswered questions attract no penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening test only; marks not counted for final merit order. Commission shortlists maximum 10 times the number of vacancies for the Main Examination.

stages.source_label: TPSC TCS & TPS Combined Competitive Main Examination Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Language Paper I: English Essay, Précis Writing & Report Writing (English Essay 40 marks, Report Writing 30 marks, Précis Writing 30 marks)
Language Paper II: English Composition & Regional Language (Section A: English Composition 50 marks; Section B: Bengali OR Kokborok OR Alternative English 50 marks)

General Studies Paper I (Section A: GK & Current Affairs 25m, Science & Technology 25m, Numerical Ability 25m, Reasoning 25m in MCQ format with 0.25 negative marking; Section B: Environmental Conservation 25m, Security & Disaster Management 25m in descriptive format)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 mark penalty for incorrect answers in Section A (MCQ section); no negative marking in Section B (descriptive)

papers.paper_name: General Studies Paper II (Section A: Modern History of India 50m, History of Tripura 20m, Indian Socio-Cultural Heritage & Cultural Heritage of Tripura 30m; Section B: Geography of India 35m, Geography of Tripura 15m)

General Studies Paper III (Section A: Constitution of India & Human Rights 50m, Indian Political System & Governance 35m, Political & Administrative System of Tripura 15m; Section B: Foreign Policy of India & External Relations 25m, International Organizations & Global Issues 25m)

General Studies Paper IV (Section A: Indian Economy 30m, Budgetary, Fiscal & Monetary Policy 30m, Banking & Financial Markets 30m; Section B: Social Security Measures & Welfare Programs 30m, Economy of Tripura 30m)
Personality Test / Interview (Evaluation of administrative suitability, intellectual acumen, social awareness, moral integrity, leadership capabilities, and balanced judgement)

financial_package.note: Direct recruitment to Tripura Civil Service Grade-II is made at Pay Matrix Level 14 with entry basic pay of ₹54,000 under the Tripura State Civil Services (Revised Pay) (First Amendment) Rules, 2018 (corresponding to pre-revised PB-4 ₹15,600 - ₹39,100 + Grade Pay ₹5,400 under Tripura ROP 2017). Allied administrative posts recruited via Miscellaneous CCE are placed at Level 12 (Superintendent of Taxes, Entry Basic ₹42,900), Level 10 (Inspector of Small Savings, Entry Basic ₹34,700), and Level 9 (Supervisor, Entry Basic ₹27,300).
financial_package.pay_level: Level 14 in the Tripura State Pay Matrix (Entry Basic ₹54,000; pre-revised PB-4 ₹15,600 - ₹39,100 + Grade Pay ₹5,400 under Tripura ROP Rules 2017/2018)
financial_package.pay_source_label: Tripura State Civil Services (Revised Pay) (First Amendment) Rules, 2018 Table 4 & TPSC Advt. No. 05/2022
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated based on Tripura Level 14 entry basic pay of ₹54,000 at project standard 58% Dearness Allowance (effective 1 Jul 2025; ₹31,320) plus House Rent Allowance (8% in Agartala municipal corporation area = ₹4,320, 7% in other district headquarters and subdivisions = ₹3,780), and fixed monthly Medical Allowance (₹500); net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic + DA = ₹8,532/month), Tripura State Employees Group Insurance Scheme (GIS, ₹300/month), and Professional Tax (₹200/month).
official_perks: Designated government residential accommodation / official bungalow as per district entitlement
Official government vehicle with driver for SDM, BDO, and Deputy Collector executive field administration
Armed personal security officer (PSO) for executive magisterial duties in sub-divisional postings
Medical reimbursement facilities under the Tripura State Medical Attendance Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment under Tripura State Service Rules
Broadband internet, telephone expense, and newspaper allowance as per administrative cadre entitlement
